title: Dr. Stone
synopsis:
After five years of harboring unspoken feelings, high-schooler Taiju Ooki is finally ready to confess his love to Yuzuriha Ogawa. Just when Taiju begins his confession however, a blinding green light strikes the Earth and petrifies mankind around the world—turning every single human into stone.

Several millennia later, Taiju awakens to find the modern world completely nonexistent, as nature has flourished in the years humanity stood still. Among a stone world of statues, Taiju encounters one other living human: his science-loving friend Senkuu, who has been active for a few months. Taiju learns that Senkuu has developed a grand scheme—to launch the complete revival of civilization with science. Taiju's brawn and Senkuu's brains combine to forge a formidable partnership, and they soon uncover a method to revive those petrified.

However, Senkuu's master plan is threatened when his ideologies are challenged by those who awaken. All the while, the reason for mankind's petrification remains unknown.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Stone World
episodes_data.description: Senku and Taiju emerge from their petrification several thousand years after everyone in the world had turned to stone. It’s up to them to rescue everyone else and restore civilization.

episodes_data.title: King of the Stone World
episodes_data.description: Taiju and Senku are about to revive Yuzuriha, when they get attacked by lions.

episodes_data.title: Weapons of Science
episodes_data.description: Tsukasa has learned about the cave where the nitric acid is collected. The race is on between Senku and Tsukasa to restore humanity in their respective visions.

episodes_data.title: Fire the Smoke Signal
episodes_data.description: Senku, Taiju and Yuzuriha head to Hakone to collect sulfur for gunpowder, which they’ll need to fight Tsukasa. They accidentally set off an explosion, which attracts some unexpected attention.

episodes_data.title: Stone World the Beginning
episodes_data.description: Tsukasa demands that Senku abandons science, but there’s no way he can do that. Tsukasa is left with no choice but to kill him.

episodes_data.title: Two Nations of the Stone World
episodes_data.description: Taiju and Yuzuriha figure out Senku’s secret to reviving him. But now that he’s back, they need to deal with Tsukasa.

episodes_data.title: Where Two Million Years Have Gone
episodes_data.description: Kohaku shows Senku to her village, but it’s going to take some convincing before they let him in. In the meantime, he makes friends with a like-minded, promising “sorcerer.”

episodes_data.title: Stone Road
episodes_data.description: Kohaku’s sister, village priestess Ruri, is gravely ill. Senku, Chrome and Kohaku begin their quest to make antibiotics to save her life.

episodes_data.title: Let There Be the Light of Science
episodes_data.description: Senku starts a ramen stand in hopes of winning over support for his kingdom of science, but some people are too principled to take such a bribe. Mentalist Asagiri Gen is not one of them.

episodes_data.title: A Flimsy Alliance
episodes_data.description: Senku and his kingdom of science successfully test the first lightbulb since the collapse. Meanwhile, Asagiri Gen, a spy from Tsukasa’s empire, is killed by an unknown attacker.

episodes_data.title: Clear World
episodes_data.description: The development of glassworks, an important step for making sulfa drugs and for chemistry as a whole, turns out to have a surprising benefit for Suika.

episodes_data.title: Buddies Back to Back
episodes_data.description: To make antibiotics, Senku and his kingdom need to obtain sulfuric acid from a fountain of the stuff. The team goes prepared, but there’s no guarantee that they’ll make it back alive.

episodes_data.title: Masked Warrior
episodes_data.description: All that’s needed to make antibiotics is alcohol. The best way to get some is to win the Grand Bout, which the Senku and his kingdom will also need to do in order to keep Magma away from Ruri and give her the drug.

episodes_data.title: Master of Flame
episodes_data.description: The Grand Bout is on. The kingdom of science must defeat Magma and take the seat of the village chief in order to give Ruru the antibiotic and win over the village.

episodes_data.title: The Culmination of Two Million Years
episodes_data.description: With Magma defeated, it’s down to Senku and Ginro to take the throne. Although both are on the same team, one is driven by personal greed and opportunism. The fight is on!

episodes_data.title: A Tale for the Ages
episodes_data.description: Having won the Grand Bout fair and square, and having cured village priestess Ruri of her pneumonia, Senku has won the hearts and minds of the village. Ruri delivers Senku a message from someone dear.

episodes_data.title: A Hundred Nights and a Thousand Skies
episodes_data.description: Through Byakuya’s message to Senku, we learn of the events that started Ishigami Village.

episodes_data.title: Stone Wars
episodes_data.description: Tsukasa’s army attacks the village, potentially leaving them with no choice but to cut down the bridge and lose Kinro.

episodes_data.title: To Modernity
episodes_data.description: Tsukasa’s army attacks the village. Outmatched by the attackers, they have to rely on wits, cooperation and science to fend them off.

episodes_data.title: The Age of Energy
episodes_data.description: Tsukasa plans a second attack after a few months of preparation. He has no idea what Senku and his kingdom are cooking up in the meantime.

episodes_data.title: Spartan Crafts Club
episodes_data.description: Making cell phones takes a lot of materials and tools. Senku begins by upgrading their equipment using the waterwheel Chrome and Kaseki invented and built together.

episodes_data.title: The Treasure
episodes_data.description: Making cell phones takes a lot of materials and tools. Senku begins by upgrading their equipment using the waterwheel Chrome and Kaseki invented and built together.

episodes_data.title: Wave of Science
episodes_data.description: Now that the kingdom of science has access to tungsten, they can finish building the cell phone.

episodes_data.title: Voices over Infinite Distance
episodes_data.description: Now that the kingdom of science has access to tungsten, they can finish building the cell phone.

specials_data.title: Behind the Scenes of Dr. Stone
specials_data.description: Crunchyroll takes you behind the scenes of this season’s biggest show, Dr. STONE. Meet the Producer, Shusuke Katagiri, and Director, Shinya Iino, as they take us through the process of creating a hit anime. From storyboards to screens, see the making of an episode of Dr. STONE.

background: Dr. Stone adapts chapters 1-60 of the manga.
